_source: SYNTHETIC (SHARE-02): shaped after Gmail API format=full Authentication-Results headers, with invented local parts (***), recipient and relay domains on example.test, documentation IPs (RFC 5737) and invented selectors and subjects. The publisher domains stay because publisher_email pins them. DKIM b= values cut. TRIG-03 AC-10 must pass every case in `pass` and refuse every case in `refuse`.
